description: "Curated courses and learning materials for infectious disease modelling, epidemiological statistics, mathematical epidemiology, stochastic processes, and network science."
execute:

---

This page collects selected courses, summer schools, online materials, textbooks, and tutorials for infectious disease modelling and adjacent methods.

The list is manually curated. Course dates, fees, eligibility, and application deadlines may change; always check the official page. The `last_checked` field records when each entry was last reviewed.

## Suggested routes

| Goal | Suggested resources |
|---|---|
| Regression and epidemiological statistics | Imperial/Coursera public-health R specialization; Nahhas book; Wageningen Advanced Analytical Epidemiology |
| Basic infectious disease modelling | FUN-MOOC or Imperial/Coursera Infectious Disease Modelling; LSHTM introduction course |
| Implementing transmission models | LSHTM Modern Techniques in Infectious Disease Modelling |
| Fitting infectious disease dynamic models | Statistical Rethinking; LSHTM Model Fitting and Inference |
| Mathematical epidemiology | Diekmann, Heesterbeek & Britton; Keeling & Rohani |
| Stochastic epidemic models | ESPIDAM stochastic epidemic models course; Allen primer; Britton notes |
| Network and contact-pattern modelling | Utrecht Network Science; ESPIDAM Networks and contact patterns; SISMID Network Modeling for Epidemics |
| Stochastic-process foundations | MIT OCW Introduction to Stochastic Processes; MITx Probability |

## Resource database

Use the search box and filters to narrow the list. Click column headers to sort.

```{r, results='asis'}
# Read data ---------------------------------------------------------------

csv_candidates <- c(
  "data/training_resources.csv",
  "resources/data/training_resources.csv"
)

csv_path <- csv_candidates[file.exists(csv_candidates)][1]

if (is.na(csv_path)) {
  stop("Could not find data/training_resources.csv. Place it in resources/data/training_resources.csv.")
}

resources <- read.csv(
  csv_path,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  encoding = "UTF-8"
)

category_order <- c(
  "Epidemiological statistics and regression",
  "Infectious disease modelling and outbreak analytics",
  "Mathematical epidemiology and stochastic epidemic models",
  "Probability and stochastic processes",
  "Network science, complex systems, and ABM",
  "Books, papers, and reference materials"
)

relevance_order <- c("core", "recommended", "specialized", "reference", "archived")

resources$category <- factor(resources$category, levels = category_order)
resources$relevance_rank <- match(resources$relevance, relevance_order)
resources <- resources[order(resources$category, resources$relevance_rank, resources$title), ]

# Helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------

html_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "", x)
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

attr_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- html_escape(x)
  x <- gsub("'", "&#39;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

short_topics <- function(x, n = 5) {
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "", x)
  parts <- trimws(strsplit(x, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
  parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]
  if (length(parts) <= n) {
    paste(parts, collapse = "; ")
  } else {
    paste0(paste(parts[seq_len(n)], collapse = "; "), "; …")
  }
}

option_tags <- function(values) {
  values <- sort(unique(as.character(values)))
  values <- values[nzchar(values)]
  paste0(
    vapply(values, function(v) {
      paste0("<option value='", attr_escape(v), "'>", html_escape(v), "</option>")
    }, character(1)),
    collapse = "\n"
  )
}

badge_class <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(ifelse(is.na(x), "", x))
  x <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", x)
  x <- gsub("(^-|-$)", "", x)
  ifelse(nzchar(x), x, "unknown")
}

# JavaScript --------------------------------------------------------------

cat('
<script>
(function() {
  const table = document.getElementById("resource-table");
  const rows = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll("tbody tr"));
  const search = document.getElementById("resource-search");
  const category = document.getElementById("resource-category-filter");
  const level = document.getElementById("resource-level-filter");
  const status = document.getElementById("resource-status-filter");
  const count = document.getElementById("resource-visible-count");
  const noResults = document.getElementById("resource-no-results");

  function normalize(s) {
    return (s || "").toLowerCase();
  }

  function applyFilters() {
    const q = normalize(search.value);
    const c = category.value;
    const l = level.value;
    const st = status.value;
    let visible = 0;

    rows.forEach(row => {
      const matchSearch = !q || row.dataset.search.includes(q);
      const matchCategory = !c || row.dataset.category === c;
      const matchLevel = !l || row.dataset.level === l;
      const matchStatus = !st || row.dataset.status === st;
      const show = matchSearch && matchCategory && matchLevel && matchStatus;
      row.style.display = show ? "" : "none";
      if (show) visible += 1;
    });

    count.textContent = visible;
    noResults.style.display = visible === 0 ? "block" : "none";
  }

  [search, category, level, status].forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener("input", applyFilters);
    el.addEventListener("change", applyFilters);
  });

  let sortState = { key: null, asc: true };

  table.querySelectorAll("th[data-sort]").forEach(th => {
    th.addEventListener("click", function() {
      const key = th.dataset.sort;
      sortState.asc = sortState.key === key ? !sortState.asc : true;
      sortState.key = key;

      const tbody = table.querySelector("tbody");
      const sorted = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => {
        const av = normalize(a.dataset[key]);
        const bv = normalize(b.dataset[key]);
        if (av < bv) return sortState.asc ? -1 : 1;
        if (av > bv) return sortState.asc ? 1 : -1;
        return 0;
      });

      sorted.forEach(row => tbody.appendChild(row));
      rows.splice(0, rows.length, ...sorted);
      applyFilters();
    });
  });

  applyFilters();
})();
</script>
')
```

## Data and maintenance

The source of truth is [`data/training_resources.csv`](data/training_resources.csv). To update the page, edit the CSV and render the site again.

Suggested maintenance rules:

- keep one resource per row;
- update `last_checked` whenever an entry is reviewed;
- use official course pages as URLs whenever possible;
- keep `notes` short;
- do not delete past courses immediately if they are likely to recur;
- use `status = unknown` when the current status is unclear.

Inclusion in this list does not imply endorsement by any affiliated institution.
